content:
Non-inventory Item

Create items for services or products that you don't track in inventory.

Non-inventory items are useful for services, labor, or items you purchase and sell without stocking.

Code

Optionally, enter an item code. This helps identify the item quickly and can be used instead of the full name when creating transactions.

Name

Enter the name of the non-inventory item, such as 'Consulting Services', 'Shipping', or 'Installation Fee'.

Unit Name

Optionally, specify the unit of measurement, such as 'hour', 'each', 'service', or 'month'. This appears on invoices and other documents.

When sold

Select the income account to credit when this item is sold. This is typically a revenue or sales account.

When purchased

Select the expense or asset account to debit when this item is purchased. This could be an expense account or cost of goods sold.

Autofill — Line description

Check this box to set a default description that will automatically appear when this item is selected in transactions.

DefaultLineDescription

Enter the default description text that will appear on invoices, quotes, and other documents when this item is selected.

Autofill — Sales — Unit price

Check this box to set a default selling price that will automatically fill when creating sales transactions.

DefaultSalesUnitPrice

Enter the default selling price per unit. This can be overridden on individual transactions.

Autofill — Purchases — Unit price

Check this box to set a default purchase price that will automatically fill when creating purchase transactions.

DefaultPurchaseUnitPrice

Enter the default purchase price per unit. This can be overridden on individual transactions.

Autofill — Tax Code

Check this box to set a default tax code that will automatically apply when this item is used in transactions.

DefaultTaxCode

Select the default tax code for this item. This determines the tax rate applied when the item is sold or purchased.

Autofill — Division

Check this box to assign a default division that will automatically apply when this item is used in transactions.

DefaultDivision

Select the default division for this item. This helps track income and expenses by division when this item is used.

Hide item name on printed documents

Check this box to show only the item code (not the name) on printed documents like invoices. Useful for internal codes you don't want customers to see.

Inactive

Mark this item as inactive to hide it from dropdown lists while preserving historical transactions. Useful for discontinued items.
